book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Sesoa Yakopmba Kolvrelmona Awothona.
Doa Sesoa Yakopm ishomnana, honaminioa pho, Betella di avhoao. Wo honoa kamoa di songowol veno, kav ten yem seilm nonglaphonam, nonam pev etepevnamini pem gavnam.
Doa Yakopva hellenamba, hevtindim unna, yeoa meilna viu,

pimba Betellam ata angavav. Wo di si kava honmba songowol venavav Sesoamba, temba kamba kolvrenamba, nonamba kamba kin venavna eteindava. Kava nohalva nohalva aevluwul vevnamba, himba kamba mongawulm waiavna.

Doa yeoa mana vemamoa tihrinioa dembranga viu, temba yimba iaevpa, wo besalangas kayenoa vewol viu, besal wevsam engu. Doa hevtindiva hillinamba, mana vemamba aongrini, tihrini os dembrahuna, wo himba pethara singvewol vena timingra Sekem kembella.
Doa Yakoptindiva angalm vevnamba, Sesoava kekalvho vrinvna, wo ungundva pem esvema vivna, himba engilangavnamoa sisva, owai.
Doa wonganamba, Betella di wonpho,

doa di hon songowol venamba, os sevrana, memba pethava El Betel, osm ovna, Sesoa Betelna. Manara, Sesoava seilva di hemba nonglaphonamba, nonamba himba etelnaminiva pemba gavnamba. No pethava seilva os sevrivna Lus.
Doa diva wonavnamba, ungevlirinimba os dahana Deporamba, himba Reselna andranind unguvlirini avna. Dahanamba, di singvina timingra Betella murapeta. Noinda no timba osva sevrivna, wuo ovna.
Doa Yakopva di Betella wonavna, doara Mesopotamia petharini wonpronamba, wo Sesoa henga nonglaphona, henga kolvrelmona awothona.
Omnana, yemba doara os awona Yakopm, heva os si yemba sevrivav, Israel. Noinda Sesoava hemba henga os awona Israelm.
Doa mendah omnana, kava Sesoa mendekli lohv, wo yeoa otolmoa mindnam towand veo. Si yetindiva mindnam phovav no pethara, no pethara, wo si monglava mendekli pulvovav hovrava.
Wo nomba pethamba kava yemba si indthueinvav, temba kava doarava indthueinnamba Aprahamimba Isakimba, wo si yetindimba kava wohkovorahunvav.
Doa Sesoava os wohvongana,
wo Yakopva honmba indund vilindthoana, hevna nengavnangm tuhholm, doa wainpol olivpol no honsra sovhomnana Sesoam.
Doa henga no pethamba sevrana Betel.
Reselm Dahana.
Doa Yakopva Betelnamini wongavna, Epratmonam wongavna. Angavna, doa mendah Epratva oklapeta lohvna, doa Reselmba kelathamnavna, noinda ena avna. Wo himba os vevna, ata hi kava lengvav?
Doa kinsomb mendekli venavna, mongo ungevlirini kevruwulavna, omnana, manapenam, doa lengpev otolva.
Heva os hemba dahalm vevna, wo otolmba awovna, os hemba wohdahana. Os awona, Benonim, wo aralva henga awona, Bensaminm.
Doa Reselmba dahamnanamba, di singvina Eprata mona pethalla. Epratava nomba daipotava os ningthiv, Betlehemkembel. Singvinamba,
Yakopva hon di indund vilindthoamnana, wo mendah vilindtholohv Reselna pokamahulsra.
Doa nomini wonganamba, di wonavhoana Miktaleterra nohalm.
Doa diva himba wonavnamba, Yakopna yiveltowondva Rupenmba phonamba, Bilham kevrana, wailina, Bilhava nomba aralna andranind unguvlirini. Doa aralva hellenamba, hemba noinda musk mindnam venavna os i.
Doa Yakopna ombtowondalva os lovahvna, yiveltowondva Rupen, avalva Lea. Wo Leanamba monglava ombolva Simeon, Levi, Yuta, Isakar, Sepulun.
Reselnamba ombolva Yosep, Bensamin.
Reselnamba andranind unguvlirininamba Bilhanamba ombolva Dan, Naptali.
Leanamba andranind unguvlirininamba Silpanamba ombolva Gat, Aser. Memba ombolva 12pelarava Yakop tetwond vena di okla Mesopotamia pethara hevna meralinda.
Isakm Dahana.
Doa Yakopva aralindam gana Mamreram, ten doara Aprahami Isaki ahalohvnam. Di mura lohv Hepron kembella, doara ningthivna Kiriatapa.
Doa Isakva osomba os vena 180pelara, mundkolalnonoa avna,
doa os dahana, wo ombol sambla Esaui Yakopi hemba di esingvena.
